title: Chuka
description: A bearded gunfighter (Rod Taylor) tries to forewarn a colonel (John Mills) and a sergeant (Ernest Borgnine) about an Indian raid on their fort.

title: The Book of Eli
description: A drifter fights his way across a ravaged, post-apocalyptic America while protecting a sacred book that holds the secrets to humanity's salvation.

title: Sing, Cowboy, Sing
description: A singing cowboy (Tex Ritter) shields a girl (Louise Stanley) from killers after her freight-wagon franchise.

title: When Calls the Heart
description: Elizabeth confronts Nathan about his parenting style; Bill is offered a judgeship, but is unsure if he wants to take it; Rosemary hosts a girls-only night; Faith and Carson's romance blooms; Jesse finds surface oil, but can't afford to drill.

title: When Calls the Heart
description: Gowen strikes oil, which splits Hope Valley into the haves and have-nots; Bill must settle a dispute among landowners; Nathan urges Bill to re-examine the judgeship offer; Rosemary must come clean to Lee about a deep, emotional anxiety she feels.

title: When Calls the Heart
description: Trying to stay on Elizabeth's good side, Lucas sets up a library for the town; Allie tricks Harper, Robert and Opal into believing the town has a haunted house; Bill conducts his first trial as a judge in Hope Valley when Jesse sues Gowen.

title: When Calls the Heart
description: Lucas' past comes back to haunt him and others in Hope Valley; Lee and Gowen compete for workers; an old friend arrives with a new orphan.

title: When Calls the Heart
description: At the Founders' Day Festival, Elizabeth makes a move that might affect her future; an orphan struggles to accept his new life; Bill finds startling information about Gowen.

title: The Young Riders
description: The riders move into new territory when Teaspoon is assigned to rebuild the way station that was destroyed by renegades in the city of Rock Creek.

title: The Young Riders
description: The riders befriend a 14-year-old boy who has come to Rock Creek with the purpose to find the men who killed his foster father.

title: The Young Riders
description: Hickok, Lou and the Kid tangle with a vengeful ex-lawman while escorting a desperado to his execution.

title: The Young Riders
description: The riders become involved in a murder investigation when a Union Army recruiter is found stabbed following an argument with Noah.

title: The Young Riders
description: One of the riders is killed by a stray bullet during a shootout and another seeks revenge for his friend's killing.

title: Hell on Wheels
description: Cullen and Durant meet with President Grant to discuss the future of the railroad; the Swede puts his plan against the Mormons in action.

title: Hell on Wheels
description: When the Swede goes on a murderous rampage on the Hatch homestead, a long-overdue showdown with Cullen ensues.

title: Hell on Wheels
description: Cullen considers life-changing decisions in Utah; Truckee adapts to life without Cullen; lies compromise Durant's new partner.

title: Hell on Wheels
description: Cullen's nitroglycerin experiment makes an explosive backdrop for the railroad life in Truckee; Durant's plan takes a deadly turn.

title: Hell on Wheels
description: Mickey has blood on his hands after working with Durant; Campbell returns to town, complicating Louise's life.

title: Red Hill
description: A rookie cop (Ryan Kwanten) must contend with an escaped murderer (Tom E. Lewis) who has come to town seeking revenge.

title: Cimarron
description: Husband-and-wife homesteaders (Glenn Ford, Maria Schell) spend 25 years in Oklahoma after the great land rush of 1889.

title: Warden of Red Rock
description: A warden (James Caan) discovers that a new inmate (David Carradine) in his Arizona prison was also his former partner in crime.

title: Texas Terror
description: A former lawman straps on his six-shooters when he discovers the identity of his best friend's killer.

title: The Tall Stranger
description: A Union veteran (Joel McCrea) joins Southern homesteaders against outlaws on his half brother's (Barry Kelley) land.

title: Renegade Trail
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and pals (George Hayes, Russell Hayden) help a widow save her herd from rustlers.

title: The Hi-Lo Country
description: A rift develops between longtime friends (Woody Harrelson, Billy Crudup) over the love of a married woman (Patricia Arquette), for whom each pines.

title: Chuka
description: A bearded gunfighter (Rod Taylor) tries to forewarn a colonel (John Mills) and a sergeant (Ernest Borgnine) about an Indian raid on their fort.

title: The Deadly Trackers
description: A peaceful Texas sheriff (Richard Harris) hunts to kill an outlaw (Rod Taylor) and his gang after they kill his family.

title: El rojo
description: A gunfighter called "El Rojo" arrives in Gold Hill to avenge his massacred family.

title: Gun Fury
description: A peaceful man (Rock Hudson) hunts down the outlaw (Phil Carey) who has abducted his bride (Donna Reed).

title: Valdez Is Coming
description: A Mexican-American lawman (Burt Lancaster) gets even with a Southwestern rancher (Jon Cypher) for leaving him to die in the desert.

title: In Old Colorado
description: Hopalong Cassidy stops Joe Weiler from instigating a prairie war between two ranchers.
